theorem_scope: Exact complete oriented two-level envelope on d=5,r=2: positive orientations dominate their negatives and the one-spike/rank-two crossing is unique; no global arbitrary-spectrum claim.
arithmetic: exact Q(sqrt(6)) Sturm sequences and symbolic integration

orientation_certificate.conclusion: For positive field each positive orientation strictly dominates its negative orientation; together with the canonical crossing, this closes the complete oriented two-level envelope.

laplace_zero_budget.reason: equal moments of orders 0,1,2 and unequal third moments
laplace_zero_budget.positive_crossing_exists: third derivative is negative at zero while the rank-two support endpoint 6 exceeds 3*sqrt(6)/2
laplace_zero_budget.conclusion: the positive crossing exists, is unique, and is simple
